source_integration: Feature-only changes replayed directly onto upstream develop; linear review commits without master merges or old mixed-history parents.

validation.status: Passed targeted source and package checks on pure upstream develop; source publication only.
validation.compiler: GCC12/C++20 with cached vcpkg SDK; targeted syntax compilation, normal source preamble for zone translation units.
validation.content_preservation: Exact added/removed source lines versus previous snapshot equal only the upstream mixed-base-to-develop delta in 11 paths. Opcode mappings/structures and other production packages retained byte-for-byte, except installer pin/checksum and current guides.
package_checks: Manifest hashes/sizes, Python syntax, JSON, guide links
Unique migration IDs, opcode names, mapping keys and handlers
validation.history: New linear review history; old heads preserved in archive branches.
validation.full_branch_link: Not independently linked; full combined build recorded by the integration branch.
validation.native_acceptance: No new native gameplay or active server/database deployment during this rebase.

database: Existing PEQ/MariaDB database plus required migrations; no PEQ fork or database dump included.
shared_core: Inherited from rof2-shared-core; one canonical implementation in common/shared_core; legacy feature headers forward to it.
remaining_feature_dependencies: Published feature/runtime dependencies are retained. Extracting shared infrastructure does not make all gameplay patches independent.
reviewed_source_repairs: Replace missing excluded crate_test_content.h with production-only crate_content_types.h; retain bounded read-only legacy manifest decoding and original digest/ownership checks. No fixtures or test data included.
Use upstream-default precompiled headers in the integrated installer, matching the validated current source rather than the historical standalone overlay build.
integration_scope: All five published features share pure upstream develop. Achievements keeps its own branch and its published content is included in integration.
history: Linear feature layers over exact upstream develop; no merge commits ahead of base.
